shortDescription: According to Wallstreetcn, Berkshire Hathaway announced that Warren Buffett was appointed honorary chairman effective immediately and will continue to serve as a board member, while the board elected Howard Buffett as chairman and Susan Decker will remain lead independent director.

title: Berkshire Hathaway Names Howard Buffett Chairman, Warren Buffett Honorary Chairman
